name: Kurowa
source:
Patty Eclaire is the owner of a local bakery in Labyrinthia. Phoenix Wright and Maya Fey ended up working for her as apprentice bakers. Espella Cantabella also worked at the baker, with Eclaire treating her like family.

[Edited from [url=http://aceattorney.fandom.com/wiki/Patty_Eclaire]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
